company.name: Respan
company.shortDescription: Respan is an AI observability platform that helps teams trace, evaluate, and monitor AI agent behavior and performance.
company.description: Respan delivers an automated evaluation agent that empowers teams to define success through metric-driven workflows, assess production agent performance, and initiate actions like prompt refinements, regression testing, and performance alerts in response to changes. The platform connects observability, evaluation, decision-making, and iteration within a single system. It is designed to analyze agent behavior, account for non-deterministic outputs, and adapt as agents evolve.
